spans.s: रि r. 5th cl. (रिणोति) To hurt or injure. r. 6th cl. (रियति) To go, to move.

रि m. (-रिः)
 1. The tone of voice by which the note Rishabha is uttered.
2. Dancing, tumbling.
 3. Waste, loss.
 f. (-रिः)
 1. Wish, desire.
 2.
Light, lustre.
 E. रा to give, aff. कि ।

री r. 9th cl. (रिणाति)
 1. To hurt, to injure.
 2. To go, to move.
 3. To
howl, as a wild beast. (ङ्) रीङ् r. 4th cl. (रीयते)
 1. To distil, to ooze,
to drop.
 2. To fall, to alight. r. 2nd cl. (रेति) To bear or conceive,
(as a child.)
